record.title: Select the next whole-sequence ADC hypothesis and capacity preconditions
record.intent: Admit selective dynamic validation only after candidate completeness and evidence-preserving capacity are resolved.
requirements: Evaluate the offline completeness review, candidate sequence and remaining hardware inputs; preserve the original full-verifier rejection as a distinct historical result.

Prefer one complete predicted sequence with divergence stops and a post-routine checkpoint over per-access rediscovery. Specify synthetic readbacks only to the degree supported by known software use, and preserve normal synchronization and thread coverage.
Resolve storage prerequisites through a separately bounded reversible plan before any guest launch. Do not discard evidence or weaken the space gate to obtain progress.
Draft plan inspect admit against the current revision and commit and push the supported successor batch before implementation. If unresolved, name the exact missing input or capacity constraint.
acceptance: A supported bounded successor or explicit unresolved condition is committed and pushed.
